records.source: Aren't these weapons cool? I might have to bring one of these home with us today.$0
records.translation: Hindi ba kahanga-hanga ang mga sandatang ito? Baka kailangan kong mag-uwi ng isa ngayon.$0

records.source: Hey, Robin is teaching me some innovative techniques this year.#$e#I'll have to show you later...$1
records.translation: Hoy, tinuturuan ako ni Robin ng ilang makabagong pamamaraan ngayong taon.#$e#Kailangan kong ipakita sa iyo mamaya...$1

records.source: I hope we win the grange display contest! You worked really hard this year.
records.translation: Sana manalo tayo sa paligsahan ng Tanghalang Bukid! Talagang nagsikap ka ngayong taon.

records.source: Come here, sit for a while! There's space on the bench for the both of us.$1
records.translation: Halika, maupo ka muna! May lugar sa bangko para sa ating dalawa.$1

records.source: It's a little funny seeing Alex stuff his face. He seems to be doing well.#$e#I hope we win the grange display contest this year!$1
records.translation: Medyo nakakatawang makitang nagpapakabusog si Alex. Mukhang ayos naman siya.#$e#Sana manalo tayo sa paligsahan ng Tanghalang Bukid ngayong taon!$1

records.source: Sandy traveled all the way from Calico Desert to be here today.#$b#It's not very often that I get to see her!
records.translation: Naglakbay si Sandy mula pa sa Disyerto ng Calico para makarating dito ngayon.#$b#Hindi ko siya madalas makita!

records.source: That lady in the graveyard predicted our future...$0#$b#Apparently, we're destined to live a happy life together.$1
records.translation: Hinulaan ng babaeng iyon sa sementeryo ang kinabukasan natin...$0#$b#Tadhana raw nating mamuhay nang masaya kasama ang isa't isa.$1

records.source: Hey, are you enjoying the festival? I'll be rooting for our grange display!$0#$e#Psst... If you're going to bet your tokens on the wheel... bet on green!$0
records.translation: Hoy, nasisiyahan ka ba sa pista? Ipagbubunyi ko ang Tanghalang Bukid natin!$0#$e#Psst... Kung itataya mo ang mga Token na Bituin mo sa gulong... sa berde ka tumaya!$0

records.source: Did you eat yet? There's almost too much to go around!$0#$e#I already ate three sandwiches... Mmm... that sauce...
records.translation: Kumain ka na ba? Halos sobra-sobra ang pagkain!$0#$e#Tatlong sandwich na ang kinain ko... Mmm... ang sarsang iyon...

records.source: Hi, honey. Good luck today in the competition. I just know you're going to shine!$0
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Sana palarin ka sa paligsahan ngayon. Alam kong magpapakitang-gilas ka!$0

records.source: Victory! I achieved a score of '216' with five fish caught... a new personal best!$1#$e#Now, I must choose a fitting prize to purchase for you with these star tokens...$0
records.translation: Tagumpay! Nakakuha ako ng iskor na '216' sa limang nahuling isda... bagong personal na rekord!$1#$e#Ngayon, kailangan kong pumili ng angkop na premyong bibilhin para sa iyo gamit ang mga Token na Bituin na ito...$0

records.source: I might ask you to watch the animals soon so I can grab some food.$0
records.translation: Baka hilingin kong bantayan mo ang mga hayop maya-maya para makakuha ako ng pagkain.$0

records.source: This blade is so elegant. Maybe some day I'll have enough money to buy one!$0
records.translation: Napakagara ng talim na ito. Baka magkaroon ako ng sapat na pera para bumili nito balang araw!$0

records.source: If you want to master the wood, you have to think like a tree...$0
records.translation: Kung gusto mong maging bihasa sa paggawa sa kahoy, kailangan mong mag-isip na parang puno...$0

records.source: Sheep have remarkable memory capabilities... retaining familiarity with both fellow sheep and humans...$0#$e#They even form friendships, mirroring the close bonds we humans cultivate with one another!$1
records.translation: Pambihira ang kakayahan ng mga tupa sa pag-alala... natatandaan nila ang kapuwa tupa at mga tao...$0#$e#Bumubuo pa nga sila ng pagkakaibigan, tulad ng malalapit na ugnayang binubuo nating mga tao sa isa't isa!$1

records.source: There's so much to do! I don't know where to begin.$0
records.translation: Napakaraming maaaring gawin! Hindi ko alam kung saan magsisimula.$0

records.source: That lady told me my fortune. I don't know what to make of it...$0
records.translation: Hinulaan ng babaeng iyon ang kapalaran ko. Hindi ko alam kung ano ang kahulugan nito...$0

records.source: Animals are kind of like little people... they also have feelings and emotions.$0
records.translation: Parang maliliit na tao ang mga hayop... may damdamin at emosyon din sila.$0

records.source: I'm confident that I'll emerge victorious in this year's grange display competition!$1
records.translation: Tiwala akong ako ang magwawagi sa paligsahan ng Tanghalang Bukid ngayong taon!$1

records.source: Some of the produce in our grange display came from my little greenhouse. We've been carefully growing this stuff all year!$0
records.translation: Nagmula sa munting Bahay-Salamin ko ang ilan sa mga ani sa Tanghalang Bukid natin. Buong taon naming maingat na inalagaan ang mga ito!$0

records.source: Every hundred rounds of the strength game I win, I eat another BBQ sandwich.$0
records.translation: Sa bawat sandaang ikot na napapanalunan ko sa larong lakas, kumakain ako ng isa pang sandwich na barbecue.$0

records.source: %George is on the verge of falling asleep.
records.translation: %Halos makatulog na si George.

records.source: Hee hee... Maybe I should start a collection of clown figurines...
records.translation: Hee hee... Baka dapat akong magsimulang mangolekta ng mga pigurin ng payaso...

records.source: Greetings, @! The 'Stardew Valley Fair' is finally here and the crowd is growing by the minute.#$b#Just like last year, I've set up an empty grange display for you. Speak with me when you're ready to commence the judging.
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating, @! Narito na sa wakas ang 'Perya ng Stardew Valley' at dumarami ang mga tao bawat minuto.#$b#Gaya noong nakaraang taon, naghanda ako ng bakanteng Tanghalang Bukid para sa iyo. Kausapin mo ako kapag handa ka nang simulan ang pagsusuri ng mga hurado.

records.source: It's heartening to see others take an interest in my work. Makes me feel like I'm doing something good in the world.#$e#I finished some of these pieces just last week. Please inspect them closely, I stand behind my work!
records.translation: Nakapagpapasiglang makitang interesado ang iba sa gawa ko. Ipinadarama nitong may ginagawa akong mabuti sa mundo.#$e#Noong nakaraang linggo ko lang natapos ang ilan sa mga ito. Pakisuri nang mabuti; pinaninindigan ko ang gawa ko!

records.source: *phew* After being on my feet all day, it's nice to finally take a moment to relax.$0
records.translation: *hay* Matapos tumayo buong araw, masarap na makapagpahinga sa wakas.$0

records.source: Life don't get much better than this, kid!$1
records.translation: Wala nang hihigit pa rito sa buhay, bata!$1

records.source: When Sandy and I were kids, we joked about running away from it all and joining the circus.$0#$e#I don't think we would've actually gone through with it, but it's fun to imagine.$1
records.translation: Noong mga bata pa kami ni Sandy, nagbibiro kaming tatakas sa lahat at sasali sa sirko.$0#$e#Sa tingin ko, malamang ay hindi talaga namin iyon itinuloy, pero masayang isipin.$1

records.source: I'm trying to maintain a diet this fall... but I can't resist these juicy burgers!$h
records.translation: Sinisikap kong magdiyeta ngayong taglagas... pero hindi ko mapigilan ang sarili ko sa malinamnam na mga burger na ito!$h

records.source: Oh no. Who's responsible for littering here?$2#$e#Every year we get some tourists that don't respect our town...$2
records.translation: Naku. Sino ang nagkalat dito?$2#$e#Bawat taon, may ilang turistang hindi gumagalang sa bayan natin...$2

records.source: *chuckle* My son has a knack for accuracy. I wonder if he got it from me.$1
records.translation: *mahinang tawa* Talagang mahusay tumama ang anak ko. Sa akin kaya niya nakuha iyon?$1

records.source: I'm in the market for a new weapon. I wonder if I could negotiate a trade with Clint...
records.translation: Naghahanap ako ng bagong sandata. Maaari kaya akong makipagpalitan kay Clint...

records.source: Ugh... I gambled and lost it all to the spinning wheel...$2#$e#I should've went with green.$0
records.translation: Ugh... Tumaya ako at nawala ang lahat sa umiikot na gulong...$2#$e#Dapat ay sa berde ako tumaya.$0

records.source: I think Robin and I make a pretty good team, don't you think?
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, mahusay kaming koponan ni Robin, hindi ba?

records.source: The animals have been given their favorite foods, so they're happy.$h#$e#Feel free to pet them, they won't bite.
records.translation: Ibinigay sa mga hayop ang paborito nilang pagkain, kaya masaya sila.$h#$e#Huwag mag-atubiling haplusin sila; hindi sila nangangagat.

records.source: My animals had a successful year! I'm hoping the high-quality produce will impress the judges.$1#$e#How's your grange display, @? It's your moment to showcase the fruits of your labor.$0
records.translation: Matagumpay ang taon ng mga hayop ko! Umaasa akong mapapahanga ng de-kalidad na ani ang mga hurado.$1#$e#Kumusta ang Tanghalang Bukid mo, @? Ito ang sandali mong itanghal ang bunga ng pagsisikap mo.$0

records.source: Ah, don't mind the smell... I just emerged from the fishing booth with a sizable haul!$1#$e#Now, I must decide what to do with all these star tokens...$0
records.translation: Ah, huwag mong pansinin ang amoy... Kakalabas ko lang sa tolda ng pangingisda na may malaking huli!$1#$e#Ngayon, kailangan kong magpasiya kung ano ang gagawin sa lahat ng Token na Bituin na ito...$0

records.source: Working four grills simultaneously is hard work! There's a large and hungry crowd to cater to today.$0#$e#I put a little dash of my zesty sauce in each patty. *wink*
records.translation: Mahirap magpaandar ng apat na ihawan nang sabay-sabay! Marami at gutom ang mga taong kailangang pakainin ngayon.$0#$e#Naglalagay ako ng kaunting sarsang may matapang na lasa sa bawat bilog na karne. *kindat*

records.source: I was curious about this human gathering... $0#$e#Please don't tell anyone. I'm hoping to remain hidden here...$0
records.translation: Naintriga ako sa pagtitipong ito ng mga tao... $0#$e#Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman. Umaasa akong manatiling nakatago rito...$0

records.source: If you wish to peer through the mists of tomorrow, speak to my colleague Welwick.$0#$b#She has an uncommon gift...#$e#That young man by the tree seemed intrigued by his reading, but even with my powers, I cannot probe the innermost secrets of the heart...$0
records.translation: Kung nais mong sumilip sa hamog ng bukas, kausapin mo ang kasamahan kong si Welwick.$0#$b#May pambihira siyang kaloob...#$e#Mukhang naakit ang binatang malapit sa puno sa hula niya, pero kahit taglay ko ang mga kapangyarihan ko, hindi ko masisiyasat ang pinakatagong lihim ng puso...$0

records.source: I'm astonished by the level of craftsmanship on display here. Some people are so talented!$0
records.translation: Namamangha ako sa antas ng pagkakayaring itinatanghal dito. Napakahuhusay ng ilang tao!$0

records.source: The Stardew Valley community is truly one-of-a-kind...$0
records.translation: Talagang walang katulad ang komunidad ng Stardew Valley...$0

records.source: Mooo! Moooooo!$1#$e#I'm trying to talk to the baby cows.$0
records.translation: Mooo! Moooooo!$1#$e#Sinusubukan kong kausapin ang mga guya.$0

records.source: Can I play the slingshot game again, Dad!? Please?$0
records.translation: Maaari ba akong maglaro muli ng Tirador, Tay!? Puwede ba?$0

records.source: I managed to catch several iridium-quality beauties, just in time for this year's fair!$1#$e#After our grange displays are judged I'll have to try my hand at the fishing game tent.$0
records.translation: Nakahuli ako ng ilang magagandang isdang may kalidad-iridyum, sakto para sa perya ngayong taon!$1#$e#Pagkatapos hatulan ang mga Tanghalang Bukid natin, susubukan ko ang husay ko sa tolda ng larong pangingisda.$0

records.source: I'm making friends with these birds!$1
records.translation: Nakikipagkaibigan ako sa mga ibong ito!$1
